anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Quoted: In the beginning was the Word…

pass_a_gloss: And perhaps John too, knowing this, began thus in the gospel: In beginning was the Word, and the Word was toward God, and God was the Word; this was in beginning toward God.
pass_b_english: And perhaps John too, knowing [this], began thus in the gospel: "In the beginning [was the] Word, and the Word was with [God], and the Word was God; this was [in] the beginning with God."
source_text: Καὶ τάχα [τοῦ]το καὶ ὁ Ἰωάννης ἐπιστάμ[ενος ἐ]ν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ οὕτω[ς ἤρ]ξατο· "Ἐν ἀρχῇ [ἦν ὁ] λόγος, καὶ ὁ λόγος ἦν πρὸς [τὸν] θ(εό)ν, καὶ θ(εὸ)ς ἦν ὁ λόγος· οὗτος ἦν [ἐν] ἀρχῇ πρὸς τὸν θ(εό)ν".
